verdict.rationale: Pilot's higher-tier pricing lists "Full accounts receivable" as a managed service, which suggests its team handles invoicing and collections. Nothing describes a founder-facing tool for creating and sending invoices, online payment links, or view and paid tracking; the Stripe integration is mentioned only in a general integrations context. Missing for 10: self-serve invoice creation and sending, online payment options on invoices, invoice viewed and paid status tracking, detailed AR documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
